worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.summary: Slap smelling salts across a foe's face: against a paralysed target the blow is doubled, but it also cures that paralysis. Coarse salt leaves the woken target staggering.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.use.0: Land a doubled blow while the foe is paralysed
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.use.1: Hit a paralysed target once, hard
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.use.2: Use coarse salt to leave a freshly woken target staggering
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.descript: The salt slap deals about %1$s physical damage; if the target is paralysed right now the power is doubled, and the hit then cures its paralysis (it wakes up and is no longer controlled).
Reach: %1$s blocks. Speed: %2$s blocks per tick. Hit radius: %3$s blocks. A hit pushes the target back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.coarse.o: Coarse salt on: knockback ×1.5 and the cure leaves a short stagger (slowness); in exchange the hit is about ×0.90 and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer.
Coarse salt off: the hit is about ×1.06, waking the foe cleanly and putting all of it into damage.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it spends %4$s PP to fire, then recovers for %3$s seconds and starts a %5$s second cooldown on commit.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.growth.0: At level %1$s the salts power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.growth.1: At level %1$s the salts power rises to %2$s and the coarse-salt stagger lengthens to %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.smellingsalts.preferen: On: knockback ×1.5 and the cure leaves a short stagger (slowness); but the hit is ×0.90 and the cooldown is 3 ticks longer. Off: the hit is ×1.06, waking the foe cleanly.
Slap only at targets within this distance; raise it to chase paralysed targets farther away.
On: prioritize paralyzed targets for the doubled-power hit. Off: keep the ordinary low priority without weighting paralysis.
